title: Omuleeta Amangu ow’Entebe
intro: Mu lubiri lw’omufuzi ow’amaanyi, waaliwo ekintu ekitasoboka, era bangi ne bavuganya okulaga nti baali ba mugaso. Naye, omulimu ogwo gwali gusobola okutuukirira omuntu yekka ng’akakwate ke n’okumanya okw’obwakatonda kasukka obukodyo bwonna obw’omubiri, n’abikkula akaseera akaali kagenda okuwulikika okuyita mu mirembe.
clues: Nnali mu buweereza bwa kabaka omukulu naye nga nnabbi, era nnayimirira mu kibinja kye kye yali asinga okwesiga.
Nnali si kitonde kya muliro oba ekitonde eky’amaanyi mangi mu mubiri, naye nnali nkwata ekintu eky’amaanyi ennyo.
Kabaka bwe yasaba okuleetebwa entebe ey’obwakabaka okuva mu nsi ey’ewala, nnamanya bulungi eky’okukola.
Nnayogera ku kumanya kwe nnalina okuva mu Kitabo, era nga tewali muntu yenna asobola kuddamu, entebe yateekebwa mu maaso ga kabaka.
Ekikolwa kyange tekyali kya maanyi gange, wabula okulaga nti okumanya okwa nnamaddala kuva eri Allah yekka.
Nze eyaleeta entebe ya Nnabagereka w’e Seba mu kaseera katono, nga bwe kyawandiikibwa mu Surah An-Naml.

arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِى عِندَهُۥ عِلْمٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
verse: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous." (27:40)
